_review: Every photo here was checked by eye against the product line it illustrates - the DummyJSON set on 2026-09-17, the StockSnap additions on 2026-09-20, laid out as contact sheets and kept only where the photograph shows the product. Search results that showed something else were deleted rather than shipped: a stock search for 'baby wipes' returned a bull, 'car battery' a clock and 'measuring tape' a bowl of strawberries. Re-running fetch_catalogue_images.py discards this review, so merge into this file rather than regenerating it.
